title: Redstreak Campground

services.name: Redstreak Campground
services.desc: Overlooking the Village of Radium Hot Springs, Redstreak Campground provides campers with magnificent views of the Columbia Valley and the surrounding mountains. Located in the southern most portion of Kootenay National Park, overlooking the Village of Radium Hot Springs, Redstreak Campground has a magnificent view of the Columbia Valley and Purcell Mountains. Redstreak Campground is a 242-site campground providing a variety of amenities including full hook up, semi and non-serviced sites, as well as ten oTENTik tent cabins that can be rented on a nightly basis. In the summer months participate in daily interpretive programs at Redstreak Campground, enjoy a gentle hike to the hot springs,
